sections.title: The letter o
paragraphs: The letter (o) /o/ makes the main sound /ɔ/. You hear it in (occhio) /ˈɔk.kjo/, which means eye. This letter produces two different sounds in Italian.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter o
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the back of your tongue toward the roof. Form a small circle with your lips. For the second sound, lower your jaw slightly more and make a wider circle with your lips. Feel your voice box buzz gently with your fingers.

sections.title: Reading the letter o
paragraphs: In unstressed syllables, this letter makes the sound /o/, that is, a closed sound, as in (sole) /ˈso.le/. In stressed syllables before certain consonants, it makes the sound /ɔ/, that is, an open sound, as in (notte) /ˈnɔt.te/.

sections.title: Tips for the letter o
paragraphs: Do not turn this letter into two vowels like the sound in boat. Keep your tongue completely still and hold one clear pure tone. Do not relax it into an unclear murmur when unstressed.
